title: viola calcarata subsp. zoysii
intro: Viola calcarata subsp. zoysii, commonly known as the Zoys' pansy viola, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the violet family (Violaceae). It is an herb that has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola calcarata subsp. zoysii include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
